bull.b: Rapid revenue growth indicates strong advertiser demand and effective platform adoption. Management’s Q3 outlook and roughly 30% long-term annual compounding view suggest the business can sustain expansion beyond a single quarter.

Exceptionally high margins show substantial operating leverage in AppLovin’s software-led advertising model. Continued margin expansion alongside strong growth provides internal funding capacity and supports durable earnings generation.

Free cash flow closely tracking earnings supports high earnings quality and gives AppLovin flexibility to fund product investment, strategic initiatives and shareholder returns internally, reducing reliance on external capital.

bear.b: Leverage has improved but debt still exceeds equity, leaving the capital structure exposed if advertising demand or profitability weakens. Interest and repayment obligations could reduce flexibility during a prolonged industry or execution downturn.

The platform’s growth and margin trajectory depend on a steady cadence of successful model improvements. Delayed uplifts or rising compute intensity could slow monetization gains and create lasting variability in operating margins.

Limited scalable video creative and onboarding friction constrain long-tail advertiser adoption, while newer verticals are not yet material. This keeps growth concentrated in established categories and may limit diversification of revenue.
